What the reference is (brief question 5): 'reference eigenvalues E_α,ref for the TFI model (34) were computed using the block MPS alternating optimization algorithm described in [23]' ([23] = Dolgov, Khoromskij, Oseledets & Savostyanov, Comput. It is a variational MPS energy, not an exact reference; on 4 x 4 the bond dimension cap 5000 exceeds the largest Schmidt rank 2^8 = 256, so the MPS can represent the state exactly.
